mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_macro_indicator_meta (indicator_code, indicator_name, frequency, unit, chart_type, chart_color, parent_code, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{indicatorCode}, #{indicatorName}, #{frequency}, #{unit}, #{chartType}, #{chartColor}, #{parentCode}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE indicator_name = VALUES(indicator_name), unit = VALUES(unit), chart_type = VALUES(chart_type), chart_color = VALUES(chart_color), parent_code = VALUES(parent_code), sort_order = VALUES(sort_order), status = VALUES(status)
